SETTINGS_INICIO.TITULO: What do you want to change?
SETTINGS_INICIO.TEXTO: Pick a topic. Each card shows what is ready and what is still missing.

BUSCA.NADA: Nothing with that name. Try another word.
BUSCA.RESULTADOS: No topic found | 1 topic found | {count} topics found

CONTAGEM.caixas: No channel yet | 1 channel connected | {count} channels connected
CONTAGEM.usuarios: Just you for now | 1 user | {count} users

DADOS_EMPRESA.TEXTO: Your account name, language and time zone.

PLANO.TEXTO: Your plan, the next payment and the invoices.

HORARIOS.TEXTO: When your team works and what customers get outside those hours.

CANAIS.TEXTO: WhatsApp, email, Instagram and website: where customers talk to you.

USUARIOS.TEXTO: Who can sign in and what each person can do.

TIMES.TEXTO: Groups of people to share the work.

ATRIBUICAO.TEXTO: Who gets each new conversation, how much each person can take and when the bot hands over.

PASSAGEM.TEXTO: When the CRM bot passes the conversation to someone on the team.

FUNCOES.TEXTO: Tailored access: what each person sees and can change.

RESPOSTAS.TEXTO: Texts you always use, one click away in the conversation.

ETIQUETAS.TEXTO: Names and colors to sort conversations and customers.

ENCERRAR.TEXTO: What must be filled in before a conversation is closed.

ACOES.TEXTO: Several steps in one button: tag, hand over and reply.

CAMPOS.TEXTO: More information you want to keep about each customer.

INTEGRACOES.TEXTO: Connect the platform to other systems, like the AI key.

ROBOS.TEXTO: Bots from other systems that reply in your conversations.

IMPORTAR.TEXTO: Bring in customers and conversations that live somewhere else.

LOGIN.TEXTO: Sign in with the company account, without another password.
